params.prompt: Photorealistic restaurant menu food photograph, overhead view from about 60 degrees. Egyptian nachos on a round white platter: corn tortilla chips fanned neatly around the edge, the center piled with beans, crumbled feta, white garlic sauce, cucumber salad, tzatziki, diced red onion, a swirl of green jalapeño-cilantro hummus and browned kofta (lamb and ground beef), with bright pink pickled red onions and sliced cucumber adding color. The food sits on the red-painted wooden counter of a walk-up food stand in Los Angeles. Bright natural afternoon sunlight with crisp soft shadows, 50mm lens, shallow depth of field; background softly blurred warm red and brick tones with a hint of colorful cut-paper banners. Tack-sharp focus, true-to-life textures and natural color, appetizing, real street-food look, not over-styled. No text, no logos, no labels, no people, no hands.
